title: Effects of military base closures on young adults
title_zh: 军事基地关闭对年轻人的影响
authors: David Sandberg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how young adults respond to local labor market disruptions caused by military base closures in Sweden between 1998 and 2005. The results show substantial differences in responses between men and women, reflecting the sharp gender imbalance in military roles. Affected men increase enrollment in tertiary education, particularly when living in proximity to higher education institutions. In contrast, women experience improved labor market outcomes a few years after a closure, with higher earnings and employment rates. This suggests that the structural transformation of the local labor market, following the exit of a major male‐dominated employer, benefits young women as they transition into employment in expanding sectors.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了1998年至2005年间瑞典军事基地关闭所引发的当地劳动力市场冲击对年轻人的影响。结果显示，男性和女性在应对方式上存在显著差异，这反映了军事岗位中严重的性别失衡。受影响的男性更倾向于接受高等教育，尤其是当他们居住在高等教育机构附近时。相比之下，女性在基地关闭数年后劳动力市场状况有所改善，表现为收入提高和就业率上升。这表明，随着以男性为主导的大型雇主退出，当地劳动力市场的结构性转型使年轻女性受益，她们得以进入扩张中的行业就业。

title: Volatile urbanism: Rethinking planning beyond the stability premise
title_zh: 波动城市主义：超越稳定性前提的规划再思考
authors: Zaheer Allam
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Contemporary land use policy rests on a foundational and insufficiently examined premise that the exogenous operating environment of cities will remain within historically derived parameters adequate for extrapolative planning. This paper terms that premise the stability premise and argues that its structural dissolution constitutes not a series of correctable policy failures but a fundamental reconfiguration in the conditions under which urban governance operates. The concept of Volatile Urbanismis introduced to theorise that transformation: defined as the structural condition produced when disruptions to urban operating systems arrive with a velocity, simultaneity, and cross-systemic compounding that systematically exceeds the adaptive capacity of the institutions governing those cities. Three constitutive properties are identified and theorised: (i) transmission without proximity, (ii) compounding rather than sequential disruption, and (iii) institutional lag as the primary vulnerability mechanism, with implications for urban finance, infrastructure insurance, public health systems, and municipal fiscal governance. The framework is distinguished from the cognate concepts of fragility, vulnerability, and resilience, including its most sophisticated reformulations through transformative and evolutionary resilience theory, against which it offers a theoretically bounded contribution focused on the velocity-institution mismatch as a distinct governance failure mode. Specific implications are developed for zoning and land classification, infrastructure investment appraisal, development planning, and urban finance. The paper argues that land use policy is both the domain in which the stability premise is most durably encoded and the most consequential site for its reformulation. The framework arrives at a moment when the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure, the 2023–2024 Red Sea shipping crisis, and the compound urban consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic have made the theoretical inadequacy of existing frameworks empirically evident. abstract_zh: 当代土地利用政策建立在一个基础性但未经充分检验的前提之上，即城市的外生运行环境将维持在历史参数范围内，足以支撑外推式规划。本文将这一前提称为“稳定性前提”，并认为其结构性瓦解并非一系列可纠正的政策失误，而是城市治理运行条件发生的根本性重构。本文引入“波动城市主义”概念来理论化这一转变：将其定义为当城市运行系统受到的冲击以某种速度、同时性及跨系统复合效应系统性超出治理这些城市的制度适应能力时所产生的结构性状态。本文识别并理论化了三个构成性属性：（i）无需邻近即可传播，（ii）复合而非序列性冲击，以及（iii）制度滞后作为主要脆弱性机制，并探讨其对城市财政、基础设施保险、公共卫生系统及市政财政治理的影响。该框架与脆弱性、易损性和韧性等相近概念相区分，包括通过变革性韧性理论和演化韧性理论进行的最为复杂的重新表述，并在此基础上提供了一个理论边界明确的贡献，聚焦于速度-制度错配作为一种独特的治理失效模式。本文进一步探讨了该框架对区划与土地分类、基础设施投资评估、发展规划及城市财政的具体影响。本文认为，土地利用政策既是稳定性前提被最持久编码的领域，也是对其进行重构的最关键场域。该框架提出的时机恰逢2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭、2023-2024年红海航运危机以及COVID-19大流行带来的复合城市后果，使得现有框架的理论不足在经验上变得显而易见。

title: Integrating Perennial Groundcover in Corn and Soybean Acres: Impacts on U.S. Agriculture
title_zh: 将多年生地被植物整合到玉米和大豆农田：对美国农业的影响
authors: Sagar Dahal, Amani Elobeid, John Crespi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Sustainable agricultural practices such as cover cropping can improve soil health, water quality, and carbon sequestration, yet U.S. adoption remains limited due to economic and operational barriers. We evaluate market and economic impacts of integrating perennial groundcover into U.S. corn and soybean production under six yield and cost scenarios. Results show that impacts depend on whether yields are maintained and costs remain stable. Under the most optimistic scenario, long‐term outcomes remain close to or slightly above baseline levels. In contrast, scenarios involving yield losses or sustained cost increases generate negative economic outcomes, highlighting the importance of agronomic performance and cost control.
abstract_zh: 覆盖种植等可持续农业实践能够改善土壤健康、水质和碳封存，但由于经济和操作障碍，美国对其采用仍然有限。我们评估了在六种产量和成本情景下，将多年生地被植物整合到美国玉米和大豆生产中的市场和经济效益。结果表明，影响取决于产量是否得以维持以及成本是否保持稳定。在最乐观的情景下，长期结果仍接近或略高于基准水平。相比之下，涉及产量损失或成本持续增加的情景则产生负面经济结果，凸显了农艺表现和成本控制的重要性。

title: Transmission Growth-at-Risk: How Foreign Financial Vulnerabilities Shape U.S. Growth Prospects
title_zh: 传导增长风险：外国金融脆弱性如何影响美国增长前景
authors: Ma, Sai, Stebunovs, Viktors, Temesvary, Judit
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a Transmission Growth-at-Risk (TGaR) framework that incorporates foreign financial vulnerabilities as predictors of U.S. downside growth risk. We distinguish financial conditions, which measure current tightness in credit markets, from financial vulnerabilities, which measure structural fragilities that can amplify shocks. Elevated foreign financial vulnerabilities are associated with lower U.S. growth-at-risk, with transmission through both trade linkages and dollar integration channels. Asset valuation pressures and financial sector leverage abroad have the largest estimated amplification effects. Financial conditions primarily affect near-term tail risk, while foreign vulnerabilities weigh on U.S. GDP at a medium-term horizon. Out of sample, adding foreign vulnerabilities raises the predictive score by 53 percent at the 8-quarter horizon. Crisis-episode evidence points to the same interpretation. These findings show that monitoring foreign financial vulnerabilities is important for gauging U.S. growth prospects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个“传导增长风险”（TGaR）框架，将外国金融脆弱性纳入美国下行增长风险的预测变量。我们区分了金融状况（衡量信贷市场当前紧缩程度）与金融脆弱性（衡量可能放大冲击的结构性脆弱性）。外国金融脆弱性升高与美国增长风险下降相关，其传导渠道包括贸易联系和美元一体化路径。海外资产估值压力与金融部门杠杆率具有最大的放大效应估计值。金融状况主要影响短期尾部风险，而外国脆弱性则在中期时间范围内对美国GDP产生压力。在样本外检验中，加入外国脆弱性指标后，8个季度预测期的预测评分提升了53%。危机时期的证据也指向相同解释。这些发现表明，监测外国金融脆弱性对于评估美国增长前景至关重要。

title: Does Multi-Agent Debate Improve AI Feedback on Research Papers?
title_zh: 多智能体辩论能否改善对研究论文的AI反馈？
authors: Tomas Havranek, Zuzana Irsova
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Probably not, at least for meta-analyses in economics. In a pre-registered, identity-masked, within-paper experiment, the authors of 44 meta-analyses ranked three AI reports on their own paper by usefulness for improving it: a single pass by a frontier model against two multi-agent debate tools we built and expected to win. All reports were held to a common length and template. The authors preferred the single pass, by 0.66 rank points over mad-research (95% CI 0.32 to 1.00) and 0.57 over paper-workshop (0.16 to 0.95), though paper-workshop spent roughly thirty times the tokens. Authors who recalled their journal referee report usually placed it first and never last; in a separate exercise, three AI judges almost always placed the real journal referee report last. Among the three AI reports, Gemini (the judge whose model family wrote none of the reports) would have ranked paper-workshop first in the authors' place, reversing the single-pass preference. The reversal warns against substituting an AI judge for the author. We measure perceived usefulness for finished papers; whether AI should referee papers is a separate question.
abstract_zh: 或许不会，至少对经济学领域的元分析而言如此。在一项预先注册、身份隐匿的论文内实验中，44篇元分析的作者对其自身论文的三份AI报告按改进价值进行排序：一份由前沿模型单次生成，另两份来自我们构建并预期胜出的多智能体辩论工具。所有报告均遵循统一长度与模板。作者更偏好单次生成报告，其排名比mad-research高出0.66个位次（95%置信区间0.32至1.00），比paper-workshop高出0.57个位次（0.16至0.95），尽管paper-workshop消耗的令牌数约为前者的三十倍。曾回忆过期刊审稿报告的作者通常将其列为首位且从未置于末位；在另一项独立测试中，三位AI评审几乎始终将真实期刊审稿报告排在末位。在三份AI报告中，Gemini（其模型家族未参与任何报告撰写的评审）若替代作者排序，会将paper-workshop列为首位，与单次生成偏好形成反转。这一反转警示不应以AI评审替代作者。我们衡量的是对已完成论文的感知有用性；AI是否应担任论文评审则是另一独立问题。

title: Household-Level Responses to the European Energy Crisis
title_zh: 家庭层面应对欧洲能源危机的反应
authors: Ahlvik, Lassi, Kaariaho, Tuomas, Liski, Matti, Vehviläinen, Iivo
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Cost-of-living shocks can have large and unequal effects, but causal evidence on households’ adaptive responses is scarce. Using Finnish administrative microdata from the 2022 energy crisis, we exploit variation in electricity contract expirations to identify behavioral responses in electricity use, labor earnings, financial distress, and residual consumption and savings. We find notable heterogeneity in responses that shape the final incidence: high-income households primarily reduced electricity consumption, while low-income households reduced consumption less, responding instead through increased labor supply, more payment defaults, and cutbacks in spending and savings. Longer anticipation softens but does not eliminate these impacts.
abstract_zh: 生活成本冲击可能产生巨大且不均等的影响，但关于家庭适应性反应的因果证据却十分匮乏。利用2022年能源危机期间芬兰的行政微观数据，我们借助电力合同到期时间的差异，识别出家庭在电力使用、劳动收入、财务困境、剩余消费及储蓄方面的行为反应。研究发现，影响最终冲击分布的反应存在显著异质性：高收入家庭主要减少电力消费，而低收入家庭减少电力的幅度较小，转而通过增加劳动供给、更多支付违约以及削减支出和储蓄来应对。更长的预期时间能缓解但无法消除这些影响。

title: Welfare Effects of Scale Transition From Smallholders to Large Farms: A Theoretical Framework
title_zh: 小农户向大规模农场转型的福利效应：一个理论框架
authors: Jia Cao, Haoran Li, Tao Xiong, Wendong Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study develops a theoretical framework to examine the welfare effects of scale transition from smallholders to large farms. Taking hog farming in China as an example, this study focuses on the coexistence equilibrium with both smallholders and large farms and assesses the distributional effects on rural households (independent smallholders, employed smallholders, and quitters), urban consumers, and aggregate social welfare. The simulation findings reveal that the transition to large farms results in long‐term welfare losses for employed smallholsers, as well as rural households as a whole. This outcome is attributed to a reversed income effect, whereby the initial employment gains gradually diminish as the scale of transition progresses. Conversely, urban consumers gain substantial welfare improvements owing to lower retail pork prices, which are driven by the credit advantages and technological innovations of large farms. Additionally, aggregate social welfare improves as consumer surplus outpaces smallholder welfare losses. This research unpacks the intermediary step in the transition from smallholders to large farms and provides theoretical insights for agricultural transitions in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个理论框架，用以考察从小农户向大规模农场转型的福利效应。以中国生猪养殖为例，本文聚焦于小农户与大规模农场共存均衡状态，评估其对农村家庭（独立小农户、受雇小农户及退出农户）、城市消费者以及社会总福利的分配效应。模拟结果表明，向大规模农场的转型会导致受雇小农户及农村家庭整体的长期福利损失。这一结果源于反向收入效应——随着转型规模推进，初始就业收益逐渐递减。相反，由于大规模农场的信贷优势和技术创新降低了猪肉零售价格，城市消费者获得了显著的福利改善。此外，由于消费者剩余的增长超过小农户的福利损失，社会总福利得以提升。本研究揭示了从小农户向大规模农场转型的中间环节，为发展中经济体的农业转型提供了理论洞见。

title: Partisan Media Ownership, News Content, and Policy Preferences
title_zh: 党派媒体所有权、新闻内容与政策偏好
authors: Mathieu Couttenier, Sophie Hatte, Thomas Taylor, Stephanos Vlachos
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how partisan newspaper ownership shapes news content, media demand, and policy preferences. Our setting is the 2010 takeover of the Basler Zeitung, a leading Swiss regional daily, by owners affiliated with the conservative Swiss People's Party (SVP), and its 2018 sale to a nonpartisan media group. We combine over three million articles from six German-language Swiss newspapers with municipality-level circulation data and outcomes from 160 federal referendums over twenty years. Using difference-in-differences designs that compare the Basler Zeitung to control-group newspapers and exploit cross-municipality variation in pre-takeover penetration, we trace the effects of ownership along the full chain from content to readership and voting. Partisan ownership shifts coverage toward the SVP platform, especially before referendum votes and on party-sponsored proposals. Circulation declines by 28.8 percent during partisan ownership. Losses are largest in historically left-aligned municipalities, but exposure to the newspaper remains substantial even there. At mean pre-takeover penetration, partisan ownership increases SVP-aligned vote shares by 0.34 percentage points across all referendums, implying a persuasion rate of 14.6 percent among retained, persuadable readers, with larger effects for referendums closely tied to the party platform. Overall, ownership induces both ideological sorting in media demand and persuasion among voters who remain exposed, with political effects concentrated in local environments where SVP positions are more prevalent or less strongly opposed.
abstract_zh: 本文研究党派报纸所有权如何塑造新闻内容、媒体需求及政策偏好。研究背景为2010年瑞士主要地区日报《巴塞尔报》被与保守派瑞士人民党有关联的所有者收购，以及2018年该报被出售给无党派媒体集团。我们整合了六家德语瑞士报纸的三百余万篇文章、市级发行量数据及二十年间160次联邦公投结果。通过双重差分设计（将《巴塞尔报》与对照组报纸比较，并利用收购前渗透率的跨市差异），我们追踪了所有权从内容到读者群再到投票行为的完整影响链条。党派所有权使报道向瑞士人民党纲领倾斜，尤其在公投投票前及政党提案相关议题上。党派所有权期间发行量下降28.8%，历史上左倾市镇的损失最大，但即使在这些地区，报纸曝光度仍保持较高水平。在收购前平均渗透率条件下，党派所有权使所有公投中支持瑞士人民党的投票比例增加0.34个百分点，这意味着在保留的可说服读者中说服率为14.6%，且对与政党纲领紧密相关的公投影响更大。总体而言，所有权既引发媒体需求中的意识形态分化，也对持续接触信息的选民产生说服效应，其政治影响集中于瑞士人民党立场更普遍或反对力度较弱的本地环境。

title: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
title_zh: 逆福利函数的一般理论
authors: Katy Bergstrom, William Dodds
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般性理论，用于恢复将给定税收计划视为最优的逆福利函数。该理论适用于复杂环境，包括多维税收计划、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应及外部性。研究表明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进型改革，并刻画福利改进型局部改革的集合，从而将既有结论拓展至更一般化的环境。数值分析表明，考虑此类一般性因素会对逆福利函数产生显著影响。

title: ESG is Dead, They Say. Long Live TERRA
title_zh: 他们说ESG已死，TERRA万岁
authors: Patrick Bolton, Alison LaFrance, Beatrice Weder di Mauro
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investment has moved in less than a decade from dominant paradigm to contested terrain. This paper examines the rise and recent retreat of ESG in corporate governance and financial markets. We document a marked decline in ESG engagement across corporate commitments, investor coalitions, and corporate communications. While the backlash is most visible in the United States, similar patterns appear globally, indicating deeper structural weaknesses in the ESG model. ESG relied heavily on voluntary coordination and the promise that firms could “do well by doing good”—claims that proved fragile under political and market pressure. We argue that sustainability efforts should refocus on environmental risk through a narrower framework: Transition, Emissions, and Resource Risk Accountability (TERRA).
abstract_zh: 环境、社会和治理（ESG）投资在不到十年间从主导范式转变为争议领域。本文考察了ESG在公司治理与金融市场中的兴起与近期退潮。我们记录了ESG在企业承诺、投资者联盟及企业沟通中的显著衰退。尽管这一反弹在美国最为明显，但全球范围内也出现了类似模式，表明ESG模式存在更深层次的结构性缺陷。ESG高度依赖自愿协调以及企业能够"行善获利"的承诺——这些主张在政治与市场压力下被证明是脆弱的。我们认为，可持续发展努力应通过更聚焦的框架重新聚焦于环境风险：转型、排放与资源风险问责（TERRA）。

title_zh: 货币经济学30年：无现金极限货币经济中货币相关性的再审视
authors: Ricardo Lagos
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.
abstract_zh: 摘要 伍德福德（1998）中著名的无现金限制性结论已成为大量研究的理论基础，这些研究将持有货币的成本与收益视为与货币政策传导无关。本文重新审视了这一结论，发现其依赖于一种特殊的信贷市场结构，即完全竞争、零利率的延期支付安排。研究表明，当微观结构被推广至允许内生利率和信贷中介市场势力时，该结论不再成立。这一具有影响力的结论的脆弱性，应当让广泛基于无货币模型提供货币政策建议的做法有所反思。

title: How Times Have Changed: The Impact of the 2026 Iran War on the U.S. Economy
title_zh: DP21650 时代变迁：2026年伊朗战争对美国经济的影响
authors: Lutz Kilian, Michael D. Plante, Alexander W. Richter
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The 2026 IranWar has raised the question of how exposed the U.S. economy is to geopolitical oil supply disruptions. It is widely believed that the U.S. economy has become less vulnerable to such disruptions as it has reduced its dependence on oil and changed from a major net oil importer to a net oil exporter. We develop a two-country model of the global economy with large geopolitical oil supply disruptions that distinguishes between the U.S. economy and the rest of the world. We find that the response of U.S. real GDP growth to the disruption in global oil supplies today is only one-twentieth of what it would have been in 1980. Moreover, the response of U.S. real GDP growth today is only one-sixth of the decline in the rest of the world.
abstract_zh: 2026年伊朗战争引发了美国经济对地缘政治石油供应中断的脆弱性问题。普遍观点认为，随着美国降低对石油的依赖并从主要石油净进口国转变为净出口国，其经济对此类中断的脆弱性已有所降低。我们构建了一个包含大规模地缘政治石油供应中断的全球经济两国模型，将美国经济与世界其他地区加以区分。研究发现，当前全球石油供应中断对美国实际GDP增长的影响仅为1980年时的二十分之一。此外，当前美国实际GDP增长率的下降幅度仅为世界其他地区下降幅度的六分之一。

title: Drivers of Germany’s Growth Downturn
title_zh: 德国增长放缓的驱动因素
authors: Harri Kemp
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Germany’s economy experienced a pronounced recession during 2023–24, with real GDP contracting and growth falling notably behind the rest of the euro area. This paper systematically examines the underlying causes of this downturn using four complementary approaches. We find that about 60 percent of Germany’s growth underperformance was due to lower potential growth while about 40 percent reflected cyclical factors. The downturn was broad-based, with nearly all major expenditure categories—but particularly investment and exports—weighing on activity. On the production side, the recession was concentrated in manufacturing and construction, which together accounted for the bulk of the growth gap relative to the euro area. The analysis further shows that the decline in output was driven primarily by falling productivity, especially in industry and construction, rather than by a reduction in hours worked. This decline in productivity partly reflected cyclical labor hoarding amid weak aggregate demand. However, structural challenges—including (i) longer-term subdued productivity growth due to structural factors such as persistent underinvestment in public infrastructure, skills, and innovation as well as excessive red tape; (ii) population aging; (iii) one-off adverse effects from the 2022 energy-price shock, and (iv) deteriorating external competitiveness (although the level of the current account surplus remains substantial)—amplified the cyclical downturn.
abstract_zh: 德国经济在2023-2024年期间经历了显著衰退，实际GDP收缩，增速明显落后于欧元区其他经济体。本文采用四种互补方法系统考察了此次衰退的根本原因。研究发现，德国经济增长乏力约60%源于潜在增长率下降，约40%反映周期性因素。此次衰退具有广泛基础，几乎所有主要支出类别——尤其是投资和出口——均对经济活动构成拖累。从生产端看，衰退集中于制造业和建筑业，两者合计贡献了与欧元区增长差距的主要部分。进一步分析表明，产出下降主要由生产率下滑驱动（尤其在工业和建筑业），而非工时减少所致。这种生产率下降部分反映了总需求疲软背景下的周期性劳动力囤积现象。然而，结构性挑战——包括（i）公共基础设施、技能和创新领域长期投资不足及过度官僚主义等结构性因素导致的长期生产率增长低迷；（ii）人口老龄化；（iii）2022年能源价格冲击的一次性不利影响；以及（iv）外部竞争力持续恶化（尽管经常账户盈余水平仍保持高位）——加剧了周期性衰退。

title: Managing Export Complexity: The Role of Service Outsourcing
title_zh: 管理出口复杂性：服务外包的作用
authors: Giuseppe Berlingieri, Frank Pisch
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As manufacturing firms expand globally, business services such as advertising and legal support become essential for entering new markets. Exploiting exogenous demand shocks, we document that French manufacturers increasingly outsource market-access services as they enter more destinations. We develop a theory of market-access costs in which firms weigh the managerial strain of internal provision against adaptation costs of outsourcing—a mechanism that receives empirical sup-port. Further explorations reveal that outsourcing market-access services helps explain variation in access costs related to gravity and extended gravity, affects both sunk and fixed export costs, and substantially amplifies the variety gains from trade liberalization.
abstract_zh: 随着制造业企业全球扩张，广告和法律支持等商业服务成为进入新市场的关键。利用外生需求冲击，我们发现法国制造商在进入更多目的地市场时，会越来越多地将市场准入服务外包。我们构建了一个市场准入成本理论，其中企业需权衡内部提供的管理压力与外包的适应成本——这一机制得到了实证支持。进一步研究表明，外包市场准入服务有助于解释与引力模型及扩展引力模型相关的准入成本差异，同时影响出口的沉没成本和固定成本，并显著放大了贸易自由化带来的品种增益。

title: The Variance Premium and Seasonal Momentum in Option Returns
title_zh: 期权收益中的方差溢价与季节性动量
authors: Steven L Heston, Christopher S Jones, Mehdi Khorram, Shuaiqi Li, Haitao Mo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a model-free measure of the variance premium by constructing option portfolios whose returns are highly correlated with realized stock variance. This effectively decomposes returns into realized variance minus implied variance. We apply this decomposition to document a novel quarterly cross-sectional continuation pattern in both realized variance and implied variance of individual stocks. Implied variance underanticipates the seasonality of realized variance, so options that performed well at quarterly lags continue to earn high returns in the future. Quarterly periodicity in realized stock variance only occurs on days with analyst earning revisions, suggesting an informational channel for this pattern. (JEL G12, G13, G40)
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建与已实现股票方差高度相关的期权组合，开发了一种无模型的方差溢价度量方法。该方法有效将收益分解为已实现方差减去隐含方差。我们运用这一分解，揭示了个股已实现方差与隐含方差在季度层面存在新颖的横截面延续模式。隐含方差未能充分预期已实现方差的季节性特征，因此在季度滞后期间表现优异的期权，未来仍能持续获得高收益。已实现股票方差的季度周期性仅出现在分析师盈利修正的交易日，表明该模式存在信息渠道机制。（JEL G12, G13, G40）

title: How important are within‐occupation task changes for wage growth? Evidence from administrative micro data
title_zh: 职业内任务变化对工资增长的重要性：基于行政微观数据的证据
authors: Ronald Bachmann, Gökay Demir, Colin Green, Arne Uhlendorff
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine how changes in task content over time condition occupational wage development. Using survey data from Germany, we document substantial heterogeneity in within‐occupation changes in task content. Combining this evidence with administrative data on individual employment outcomes over a 25‐year period, we find important heterogeneity in wage penalties amongst jobs that were initially routine‐task‐intensive. While occupations that remain (relatively) routine‐intensive generate substantial wage penalties, occupations with a decreasing routine intensity experience stable or even increasing wages. These findings suggest that changing task profiles of occupations is an important adaptation mechanism to technological change. They cannot be explained by composition or cohort effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了任务内容随时间的变化如何影响职业工资发展。利用德国调查数据，我们记录了职业内部任务内容变化的显著异质性。结合25年间个体就业结果的行政数据，我们发现初始常规任务密集型岗位的工资惩罚存在重要异质性。那些保持（相对）常规密集型的职业会产生显著的工资惩罚，而常规强度下降的职业则经历工资稳定甚至增长。这些发现表明，职业任务特征的改变是应对技术变革的重要适应机制，且无法通过构成效应或队列效应加以解释。

title: Investor Activism and the Green Transition
title_zh: 投资者行动主义与绿色转型
authors: Sebastian Gryglewicz, Simon Mayer, Erwan Morellec
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study impact activism, where activist investors promote green transitions in firms. This activism faces two key challenges. First, an internal free-rider problem arises when insiders and activists free-ride on each other's efforts, weakening activism's effectiveness. Second, an external free-rider problem emerges when gains from activism are reflected in stock prices, discouraging activist investment or tilting it towards firms capable of transitioning independently. Our analysis highlights how factors such as investor preferences, carbon taxes, and firms’ ownership structure — public versus private — shape the effectiveness of activism, clarifying the conditions under which activism supports, rather than hinders, firms’ green transition.
abstract_zh: 我们研究影响力行动主义，即积极投资者推动企业绿色转型。这种行动主义面临两大关键挑战。其一，内部搭便车问题：当内部人与行动主义者相互依赖对方的努力而坐享其成时，会削弱行动主义的有效性。其二，外部搭便车问题：当行动主义带来的收益反映在股价中时，会抑制行动主义投资，或使其偏向于能够独立完成转型的企业。我们的分析揭示了投资者偏好、碳税以及企业所有权结构（公有与私有）等因素如何塑造行动主义的有效性，阐明了行动主义在何种条件下能够促进而非阻碍企业的绿色转型。
